candidate.data_scope: Quantiacs cryptodaily OHLCV plus historical is_liquid only

hypothesis.primary: A scale-free Pareto skyline across risk-adjusted return, trend, momentum, drawdown resilience, and inverse volatility can isolate robust winners without collapsing heterogeneous information into one scalar score.
hypothesis.central: keep assets dominated by at most one liquid peer, then apply broad positive-state gates

controls.no_pareto: same broad gates and quality score without skyline filtering
controls.dominated_tail: destructive direction control: require at least two dominators
